newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev eases to 213-215 at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev eases to 213-215 at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 213-215 per dollar, softer than 212-213 in the morning and some three levs lower than Friday's close, after very thin interbank forex trade, dealers said.
"The lev lost another three levs to the dollar, compared to Friday's close at 210-212," one dealer said.
"Foreign currency supply has been rather low for months now and this can push the lev sharply down in the next few days if demand rises again," he added.
Dollar demand from customers however was very light today and commercial banks refrained from bidding for large foreign currency volumes due to impaired lev liquidity, another dealer said.
The central bank was not seen trading in the market but according to some dealers it had probably sold small dollar volumes directly to clients.
A bid for some $2 million from a large energy importer pressured the lev from 205 to 211 per dollar last Thursday. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
